note: Bodies ranked by US adherents from the 2020 U.S. Religion Census (ASARB) where the body is matched to a census group, otherwise by the reported US membership figure shown. Adherents include children and other non-member participants, so they differ from membership counts. (Worldwide or unscoped figures are shown but not ranked). Each body is followed by its offices, units and sees; holders marked "recorded holders" come from Wikidata and may lack end dates. Characterisations are always attributed, never ours.
